SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 2
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date, calendar_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE (fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2)
ORDER BY fiscal_week, calendar_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE (fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2)
ORDER BY fiscal_week

WITH this_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  ty.fiscal_week as fiscal_week,
  ty.fiscal_week_start_date,
  ty.fiscal_week_end_date,
  ty.net_sales as net_sales_this_year,
  ly.net_sales as net_sales_last_year,
  ROUND(((ty.net_sales - ly.net_sales) / ly.net_sales * 100), 2) as growth_pct
FROM this_year ty
FULL OUTER JOIN last_year ly ON ty.fiscal_week = ly.fiscal_week
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
